title: Normalized Koszul comparison intertwines normalized finite augmentations
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf{Q}_\ell$, its valuation ring $A$ and uniformizer $t$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $g:X\to Y$ be any morphism of schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. On the small pro-etale site of $W$, write $R_W=\varprojlim_n S_{W,n}$ and $S_{W,n}=(A/t^{n+1})_W$ with their specified projections and quotient transitions [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. The scheme and coefficient universes are independent. Use the functors $G$, $F_W$ (reductions), $H_W$ (koszuls), $D_g$ (diagramPull), $B_g$ (finite), and the predicates BalancedNormalization, QuotientUnitNormalization, KoszulNormalization, ReductionNormalization, with their literal section formulas, from [def-a1-finite-pullback-strict-tower-data]. These act on all unbounded cochain complexes of $R_W$-module sheaves; tensor products are the sheafified tensor and their signed direct-sum totalization [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product, def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. For any supplied natural isomorphisms $\lambda:G\mathbin{\ggg}F_X\cong B_g$ and $C:F_Y\mathbin{\ggg}D_g\cong B_g$ satisfying BalancedNormalization and QuotientUnitNormalization, respectively, there exists a natural isomorphism $\theta:H_Y\mathbin{\ggg}D_g\cong G\mathbin{\ggg}H_X$ satisfying KoszulNormalization on both basis vectors. For every complex $P$, the strict augmentation maps satisfy $\theta_P\,a_{GP}\,\lambda_P=G(a_P)\,C_P$ in Lean composition order. Here $a$ is tensor with the specified principal Koszul quotient augmentation [def-a1-principal-completed-koszul-towers]. No goodness, boundedness, or flatness hypothesis on $P$ is imposed.

proof.text: Constant residues and equality of all completed projections show that the coefficient map preserves the uniformizer. Apply cochain tensor pullback coherence and the action unitor to both Koszul terms. On either basis vector the map is ((x tensor e_j) tensor b) mapped to ((x tensor b) tensor e_j-prime). Preservation of the uniformizer proves compatibility with the (n+1)st-power differential and the (uniformizer,1) transition. Cochain coherence retains both differential summands and their signs, so the maps assemble into the normalized natural theta on all unbounded complexes.

Evaluate the two augmentation composites on b times a pulled homogeneous tensor x tensor e_0. BalancedNormalization and QuotientUnitNormalization give the same finite generator times pi_n(b). On e_minus_1 both augmentations are zero. The two Koszul bases generate their terms, and the tensor direct-sum inclusions together with restricted pulled pure tensors determine maps by sheafification and sheaf separation. Hence the two strict tower chain maps agree at every level and degree, for all P and for every supplied normalized pair lambda,C.

theorem koszul_augmentation_compatibility
    (lambda : G l E g ⋙ reductions l E X ≅ finite l E g)
    (c : reductions l E Y ⋙ diagramPull l E g ≅ finite l E g)
    (hlambda : ∀ P : CochainComplex (Modules l E Y) ℤ,
      BalancedNormalization l E g P (lambda.app P))
    (hc : QuotientUnitNormalization l E g c) :
    ∃ theta : koszuls l E Y ⋙ diagramPull l E g ≅ G l E g ⋙ koszuls l E X,
      (∀ P : CochainComplex (Modules l E Y) ℤ,
        KoszulNormalization l E g P (theta.app P)) ∧
      (∀ P : CochainComplex (Modules l E Y) ℤ,
        (theta.hom.app P) ≫ augmentation l E X ((G l E g).obj P) ≫ lambda.hom.app P =
          (diagramPull l E g).map (augmentation l E Y P) ≫ c.hom.app P)
